title: Binance Convert Recurring Gets Smarter: Auto-Invest Integration for Effortless Investing
text: This is a general announcement and marketing communication. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, We’re excited to launch the  Convert Recurring  function—an enhanced version of the former  Auto-Invest , now more powerful, efficient, and intuitive than ever! This feature allows users to create their ideal portfolio and automate trades according to their preferred frequency. With  zero trading fees , users can make use of this new function to leverage a  dollar-cost averaging strategy  to steadily build wealth while minimizing risk.  Introducing Binance Convert’s New Recurring Feature Zero Trading Fees:  It’s the perfect solution for both beginners and experienced investors looking for a cost-effective, hassle-free way to grow their portfolios. Flexible:  Choose from a variety of customizable portfolio plans and frequency options. In addition, easily manage and adjust your plan anytime, with no additional fees. Convenient and Accessible:  Simple to set up with minimal capital requirements, making it accessible for anyone looking to start investing. How to start Convert Recurring: Step 1:  Log in to your Binance account and click [ Trade ] - [ Convert & Block Trade ]. Step 2:  Select [ Recurring ] mode. Step 3:  Select the token pairs that you would like to convert and the amount you would like to convert on a recurring basis. Step 4:  Choose the [ Frequency ] of execution and click [ Preview ]. Step 5:  Check your order details and click [ Confirm ] to start.   Start your Convert Recurring journey!
